Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The review found no blocking items.

- The drive chains and fitted rotary axis use the setup frame.
- The nine new tests cover all ten operation kinds. They compare toolpaths, tool axes, and posted NC programs with baked meshes.
- The decision record explains the change. No golden files or UI files changed.

Local results

`cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run` passed. The app library and 48 selected integration suites passed: 657 passed, 0 failed, 10 ignored.

Safety mutation checks

1. I changed the drive-chain pose read back to `model::transform_of`. `turned_multiaxis_contour_routes_drive_chains_through_setup_frame` failed. It reported `picked chain 1 stands at z -5.000, outside the window [1.500, 3.000]`. The test passed after restoration.
2. I changed the rotary-axis facet read back to `model::world_facets`. `turned_rotary_parallel_cuts_posts_and_fits_axis_like_the_baked_part` failed. It reported `RotaryParallel: axis [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]`. The test passed after restoration.

Each mutation returned exit code 101. Each restored test returned exit code 0. The source files match their contents before the mutation checks.

Requested before merge: none.

Limits: I did not test a physical CNC machine. The tests use the machine models stated in the PR body. The ignored heavy tests and release tests were not run.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

A refresh of this PR against `main` (`983f527bd`) was tried on the maintainer's order of 2026-11-18. The refresh stopped. Nothing was pushed. The head is still c290f27c0a9bb9bd6c6200b7d3a7acd084487baa.

Why it stopped: a merge of `main` can lose a refusal.

- The text conflict is in `crates/app/src/setup_align.rs`: the module doc comment (lines 22-41) and the refusal message in `generation_problem` (about lines 447-455).
- `main` commit 67218b50e (#2287) renamed `verified_kind` to `verified_mill` and added `verified_for_machine`. There, `Kind::MillTurn => verified_mill(params) || verified_turn(params)`. Its commit message says that the 5-axis and rotary kinds stay refused on machines that are not mills.
- This PR adds the 10 5-axis and rotary kinds (`Contour5D` to `MultiAxisContour`) to the same list. Its tests prove them on `Mill` only.
- git puts the 10 kinds into `verified_mill` with no conflict marker. Through the `MillTurn` arm, an aligned 5-axis or rotary operation on a MillTurn machine then passes with no refusal. `main` refuses it today. No test on one of the two sides covers this case.

One possible resolution, for the author to decide:

- Keep the 5-axis and rotary kinds out of the `MillTurn` arm, for example with a separate `verified_multiaxis` that only `Kind::Mill` accepts.
- Put the 26-kind list of this PR into the Mill-only message branch of `main`. Keep the "on a {name} machine" message of `main` for the other machines.
- Add a test that pins the refusal on a MillTurn machine.

The refresh agent did not change the logic of the author. The draft state and the labels are not changed.

I turned PR #2433 back to a draft and pushed the merge with `upstream/main` (`7bcc13a4b`).

- Conflict and `MillTurn` refusal: I merged `upstream/main` into `crates/app/src/setup_align.rs`, moved the 10 5-axis and rotary kinds into `verified_multiaxis`, and accepted `verified_multiaxis` only on `Kind::Mill` so `Kind::MillTurn` still refuses them. `all_ten_multiaxis_and_rotary_kinds_stay_refused_on_aligned_mill_turn` in `crates/app/tests/setup_align_multiaxis.rs` and `crates/app/tests/setup_align_mill_turn.rs` pin this refusal.
- `Mill` refusal message and docs: I placed the 27-kind list in the `Kind::Mill` branch of `generation_problem`, kept the `"on a {name} machine"` message for the other machine kinds, merged the module doc comment, and updated `docs/decisions/2286-aligned-setup-multiaxis.md`. `all_ten_multiaxis_and_rotary_kinds_stay_refused_on_aligned_mill_turn` checks both message branches.

Checks after the final edit:

- Mutation check 1: adding `verified_multiaxis` to `Kind::MillTurn` failed `all_ten_multiaxis_and_rotary_kinds_stay_refused_on_aligned_mill_turn` (`Contour5D must stay refused on aligned mill-turn`). Restoring the guard passed.
- Mutation check 2: reverting the `Kind::Mill` refusal message to the 17-kind list failed `all_ten_multiaxis_and_rotary_kinds_stay_refused_on_aligned_mill_turn` on the `Probe` check. Restoring the 27-kind list passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed (`wall 11.0 min, 56 step(s), 0 failed`).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed with zero warnings.

New head: `09f33d73d3730973ee98f72cb41c9badccadde34`.

**Verdict: no blockers**

Floor review (Opus, read-only) of head `09f33d73d`. The scope is the full PR diff against `main` and the remerge-diff of the merge commit `09f33d73d`.

## Safety floor

- `verified_for_machine` (`crates/app/src/setup_align.rs:408-420`) has these arms:
  - `Mill`: `verified_mill || verified_multiaxis`. The 10 5-axis and rotary kinds are new here.
  - `MillTurn`: `verified_mill || verified_turn`. This is the same as on `main`. The 10 kinds stay refused.
  - `Lathe`, `Plasma`, `WireEdm`, `SinkerEdm`: the same as on `main`.
  - `Waterjet`: `false`, and `generation_problem` refuses it before the arm. The same as on `main`.
- `verified_multiaxis` (`setup_align.rs:386-395`) is a separate list. `verified_mill` does not contain the 10 kinds. Thus no other arm can accept them by accident.
- The refusal messages: the `Mill` branch names all 27 verified kinds. The other machines keep the `on a {name} machine` message of `main`.
- The two world reads that bypassed the alignment now use the setup frame:
  - `selection::drive_chains` uses `setup_align::pose_in` (`crates/app/src/operation/selection.rs:124`).
  - `fixture::rotary_axis_of` uses `setup_align::facets_in` (`crates/app/src/fixture.rs:268`).
  - The other `model::world_facets` and `model::transform_of` reads in `crates/app/src` are on fixtures, commands and furniture. They are not part reads of a multi-axis generator.
- No new `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` outside tests. The new source code uses `unwrap_or_default` and `?` only.
- No snapshot PNG changed. No golden file changed.

## Merge of main (remerge-diff of `09f33d73d`)

- The diff touches only `setup_align.rs`, `setup_align_multiaxis.rs` and the decision file.
- The `MillTurn` arm of `main` is kept unchanged. The `on a {name} machine` message of `main` is kept.
- `crates/app/tests/setup_align_mill_turn.rs` of `main` is unchanged in the PR diff.
- Nothing unrelated changed. This agrees with the maintainer decision of 2026-11-18.

## Pinning test

`all_ten_multiaxis_and_rotary_kinds_stay_refused_on_aligned_mill_turn` (`crates/app/tests/setup_align_multiaxis.rs:404-469`):

- It mounts a `mill-turn` machine on the aligned `Setup1`. It iterates all 10 `OpType` values.
- For each kind, it calls `setup_align::generation_problem` and also `GenerateOperation::new`. It asserts the `on a mill-turn machine` refusal from the two paths. Thus the assertion fails if the setup does not resolve to `MillTurn`.
- It also asserts that the `Mill` message names the 5-axis kinds (through `Probe`).
- The author reports a mutation check: `verified_multiaxis` added to the `MillTurn` arm makes the test fail.

Pass on an aligned `Mill`: each of the 10 kinds has a generate-and-post test that compares the turned setup with the baked mesh (path, tool axis, posted NC). Thus each kind is covered. The coverage is partial in these points only:

- Only `Contour5D` and `MultiAxisContour` also run the oblique turn `[35, 25, 40]`. The other 8 kinds run `[90, 0, 90]` only.
- `RotaryContour` and `RotaryOffset` generate with no machine mounted, and mount `tilthead.mch` only before the post.

This is a follow-up, not a blocker.

## Non-blocking findings

1. `crates/app/tests/setup_align_multiaxis.rs` is a new file with 469 lines (Code shape, 400-line files). A follow-up can move the `MillTurn` refusal test into a file of its own.
2. `crates/app/src/setup_align.rs` grows from 439 to 457 lines. The file was already above 400 lines on `main`.
3. The module doc of `setup_align.rs` now names only `SinkerBurn` on `SinkerEdm`. This agrees with the code: `SinkerSideBurn` was not in the `SinkerEdm` arm on `main`. The old doc was wrong, so the change is correct.
4. The PR body is not current. It names `verified_kind` and "nine pinning tests", and the quick gate of the first head. The current head has `verified_multiaxis`, 10 tests and the `MillTurn` pinning test. The gate on this head is named only in the author's comment of 2026-11-18T10:14Z (`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`, 56 steps, 0 failed). Before the merge, update the body with the new test and that gate result.
5. The `conflicts` label is not current. `git merge-tree` is clean (see below).

## Merge with today's `main`

`git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 09f33d73d` is clean (tree `2ac1ba8a3`, no conflicts).
